data.reason: Streaming LogDigest equals log_prefix_digest: both hash replay_lines output; concatenated lines equal raw shard bytes, forwarding-pointer shards skipped in both, end() uses iterator offsets like the cursor. Prefix loop rejects lines crossing the offset, stops at the exact boundary, so post-prefix lines match old replay_lines_from_offset: same line_no base, same version_checked/shard_version behavior, migration unchanged. Digest is self-verifying (hash of bytes actually replayed), so a mid-iteration rewrite only causes a rebuild, never a wrong trust. Cost matches old read_content_range(0,offset). Non-blocking: Projector single-event path still has a len-then-read race (pre-existing, conservative); pre-upgrade digests may force one rebuild if a legacy pointer shard sits before the cursor.
